description: Official Replicate API schema for openai/gpt-5.2

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt to send to the model. Do not use if using messages.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: A JSON string representing a list of messages. For example: [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello, how are you?"}]. If provided, prompt and system_prompt are ignored.

verbosity.description: Constrains the verbosity of the model's response. Lower values will result in more concise responses, while higher values will result in more verbose responses. Currently supported values are low, medium, and high. GPT-5 supports this parameter to help control whether answers are short and to the point or long and comprehensive.

image_input.title: Image Input
image_input.description: List of images to send to the model

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: System prompt to set the assistant's behavior

reasoning_effort.description: Constrains effort on reasoning for GPT-5.2 models. Supported values are none, low, medium, high, and xhigh.

max_completion_tokens.title: Max Completion Tokens
max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum number of completion tokens to generate. For higher reasoning efforts you may need to increase your max_completion_tokens to avoid empty responses (where all the tokens are used on reasoning).
